Package io.webagent4j.recording.replay

Interface IReplayOutcome

All Known Implementing Classes:
IReplayOutcome.Rejected, IReplayOutcome.Replayed
public sealed interface IReplayOutcome permits IReplayOutcome.Replayed, IReplayOutcome.Rejected
The result of WorkflowReplayer.replay(io.webagent4j.recording.WorkflowRecordingV2, io.webagent4j.workflow.Workflow): either a successfully replayed decision trace, or a structured, secret-free reason it was rejected before any replay was attempted.

Sealed so a caller must handle both cases explicitly - there is no default or partial replay outcome.
